request.Authorization: Bearer <jwt> required on all Users ops

Content-Type.application/json: Text-only PATCH /me (first_name, last_name, email, password, password_confirmation, remove_avatar)
Content-Type.multipart/form-data: Required when uploading user[avatar] file; other user[...] fields as form parts

jwt.afterPasswordChangeViaMe: Existing Bearer stays valid until expiry or signOut

notes: unconfirmed_email is null when no pending email change
role is player|admin — display-only for player apps; no mobile admin API

username.generation: Auto on create from first_name + last initial + #NNNN; unique case-insensitive
username.client: Display as-is from API; do not rebuild from names; do not send on PATCH

emailChange.completeVia: Auth confirmUser with token from email

password.viaMe: Logged-in change: PATCH /me with password + password_confirmation (6..128); no current_password; JWT stays valid
password.viaAuthReset: Forgot password: requestPasswordReset → resetPassword → signIn (no JWT from reset)

upload.jsonAvatar: Not supported — do not send avatar as a JSON string

avatar.registerNote: registerUser may also accept multipart user[avatar]; canonical mobile upload contract is updateCurrentUser — see this bundle

statusHandling.404: Opaque missing user — do not prompt request access
statusHandling.422: Show error.message; bind error.details to fields (details locale fr; top-level message often English Validation failed)

timeoutAndOffline.noResponse: Do not mutate local profile cache; let the user retry
timeoutAndOffline.offline: Do not queue profile writes; show offline; retry on user action when online
